title: 出行日程与物联网驱动的座舱预调节
summary: 按出发日程提前读取物联网设备信息，以人数、行李等特征组织座椅及座舱预调节。
scope: 权利要求1—3；预调节相关，不包含自主行驶、进站或补能。
sourceName: 公开专利文本（Patsnap Text Reader）

en.title: Schedule and IoT based cabin preparation
en.summary: Uses departure schedules and IoT observations to prepare cabin settings for the party and luggage.
en.scope: Claims 1–3 concern preparation, not autonomous driving or replenishment.

title: 多AI Agent跨域协同超脑
summary: 中央Agent融合状态并仲裁优先级，座舱、动力、车身、底盘、自动驾驶域分别执行功能。
scope: 权利要求1、3—5；是跨域编排机制，未证明整个场景已量产或性能已达标。

en.title: Cross-domain multi-agent coordination
en.summary: A central agent combines state and priorities while five vehicle domains handle their own functions.
en.scope: Claims 1 and 3–5 describe coordination; they do not establish production availability or validated performance.

title: 置信度门控的座舱自适应交互
summary: 对乘员、环境和车辆数据做时间对齐，过滤低置信度场景，再编排可用原子服务并监测反馈。
scope: 权利要求1；门控与编排相关，模型置信度不能代替用户授权或安全论证。

en.title: Confidence-gated adaptive cabin interaction
en.summary: Aligns occupant, environment and vehicle observations; filters uncertain scenes before orchestrating services and monitoring feedback.
en.scope: Claim 1 concerns gating and orchestration; confidence is not authorization or a safety case.

title: AI Agent行车风景自动拍摄
applicant: 广汽本田（含研究开发主体）
summary: 先检查驾驶员与车辆运行状态，再识别拍摄意图、调用车载摄像头、生成配文并保存或分享。
scope: 权利要求1—3；拍摄与安全校验链相关；公开分享在本库候选中另行确认。
sourceName: 公开专利文本（Patsnap Text Reader）

en.title: Safety-gated scenic capture
en.summary: Checks driver and vehicle state before interpreting capture intent, controlling a camera and preparing text and storage or sharing.
en.scope: Claims 1–3 concern the capture chain and gating; public sharing needs separate approval in this candidate design.

title: 车载AI与用户的双向养成
applicant: 一汽集团 / 一汽北京软件技术
summary: 初始化人格参数，根据行为事件或周期更新语言、推荐和交互策略。
scope: 权利要求1；交互风格演化相关，不证明情绪理解准确或记忆服务完整实现。

en.title: Adaptive in-vehicle assistant personality
en.applicant: FAW Group / FAW Beijing Software Technology
en.summary: Updates language, recommendation and interaction policies from a personality vector and user behavior events.
en.scope: Claim 1 concerns interaction style evolution, not verified emotion understanding or a complete memory service.

title: 适老化座舱交互
applicant: 广汽本田（含研究开发主体）
summary: 识别老年乘员后切换交互模式，用语音、面部、动作与年龄段信息理解需求。
scope: 权利要求1；适老交互相关，不包含完整接送安排；年龄识别与身份判断可纠正。
sourceName: 公开专利文本（Patsnap Text Reader）

en.title: Elder-friendly cabin interaction
en.summary: Switches to an elder-oriented interaction mode and combines speech, facial, motion and age-range information.
en.scope: Claim 1 concerns elder-oriented interaction, not a complete pickup service; age and identity inferences must be correctable.

title: 无接触监测的健康座舱服务闭环
summary: 感知、健康分析、场景决策与服务执行四层联动，观察状态并调整环境或发出提醒。
scope: 权利要求1及摘要；监测与关怀相关，风险输出不是临床诊断或疗效证据。
sourceName: 公开专利文本（Patsnap Text Reader）

en.title: Non-contact occupant monitoring and care
en.summary: Connects sensing, health analysis, scene decisions and service execution to adapt the environment or notify people.
en.scope: Claim 1 and the abstract concern monitoring and care; risk estimates are not clinical diagnoses or efficacy evidence.

title: 分级唤醒的低功耗车辆安防
applicant: 北斗智联（含共同申请主体）
summary: 熄火后先以雷达和IMU监测，事件触发摄像与音频采集，再形成车端与云端协作分析。
scope: 授权文本权利要求1；低功耗安防相关，不是儿童遗留监测或无人移车的直接证据。
sourceName: 公开专利文本（Patsnap Text Reader）

en.title: Tiered low-power vehicle guarding
en.summary: Uses radar and IMU monitoring after shutdown, wakes camera/audio sensing on events, and combines local and cloud analysis.
en.scope: Granted-text claim 1 concerns low-power guarding, not direct evidence of child presence detection or unattended relocation.

title: 乘员晕动反馈与多系统调节
summary: 融合生理、行为与环境线索，调整空调、座椅、声学和显示，并根据反馈更换策略。
scope: 权利要求1及摘要；舱内缓解反馈相关，不直接证明底盘控制或医学效果。

en.title: Motion-discomfort feedback and cabin adaptation
en.summary: Combines physiological, behavioral and environmental signals to adjust HVAC, seats, audio and displays and revise strategies from feedback.
en.scope: Claim 1 and the abstract concern cabin feedback; they do not establish chassis control or medical effectiveness.

title: AI自适应座椅按摩
summary: 结合体压与心率信息确定作用部位，动态调整按摩参数，并记录用户手工修正。
scope: 权利要求1—3；与自适应按摩机制相关，效果、安全性和传感误差需单独验证。
sourceName: 公开专利文本（Patsnap Text Reader）

en.title: Adaptive seat massage
en.summary: Combines pressure and heart-rate observations to select massage areas, adapt parameters and remember manual corrections.
en.scope: Claims 1–3 concern adaptive massage; comfort, safety and sensing errors need independent validation.

title: 多模态感知与香氛环境协同
applicant: 香谷智慧（北京） / 宁波旷世智源
summary: 把感知线索与大模型策略连接到香氛、灯光、音乐和反馈更新。
scope: 权利要求1及摘要；情绪环境机制相关；本库不沿用“疗愈”的疗效承诺。

en.title: Multimodal aroma and environment coordination
en.summary: Connects multimodal observations and model policies to aroma, light, music and feedback updates.
en.scope: Claim 1 and the abstract concern an environment mechanism; this library makes no therapeutic promise.

title: 车载原生按钮的游戏复用
summary: 将原生按钮切换到游戏模式，把姿态、力度、时长或旋转数据映射为游戏输入。
scope: 权利要求1；输入设备机制相关，不等于3A游戏、AI伴演或车辆运动效果已实现。
sourceName: 公开专利文本（Patsnap Text Reader）

en.title: Native vehicle controls reused for games
en.summary: Maps multidimensional input from native vehicle controls to game commands in a dedicated game mode.
en.scope: Claim 1 concerns game input, not proof of AAA content, AI performance or vehicle motion effects.

title: 歌曲、座舱声学与偏好联合调音
summary: 结合歌曲风格、车辆声学特征与偏好记忆生成调音参数，换车时转换偏好。
scope: 权利要求1；调音与偏好迁移相关，不是实时剧情理解或共同创作的完整实现。
sourceName: 公开专利文本（Patsnap Text Reader）

en.title: Song, cabin acoustics and preference based tuning
en.summary: Uses song features, cabin acoustics and remembered preferences to tune audio and adapt preferences across vehicles.
en.scope: Claim 1 concerns tuning and preference transfer, not complete story understanding or joint creation.

title: 调光天幕与投影联动
summary: 投影模式下让调光天幕转为不透明，配合投影装置；部分实施方式还联动座椅。
scope: 权利要求1—3；显示载体相关，未证明AI选片、内容权利或量产车型配置。

en.title: Dimmable roof and projection coordination
en.summary: Makes a dimmable roof opaque during projection, with seat coordination in some embodiments.
en.scope: Claims 1–3 concern the display surface; they do not establish AI selection, content rights or production specifications.

title: 停驻座舱的多感官游戏空间
summary: 停驻状态启用游戏，将玻璃投影、液压座椅及车内输入联动；实施例扩展至悬架、空调和香氛。
scope: 权利要求1及说明书；沉浸机制相关，不能据此认定某品牌车型已提供该完整体验。

en.title: Parked multisensory gaming cabin
en.summary: Combines parked-only game activation, glass projection, actuated seats and native controls, with optional suspension and environmental effects.
en.scope: Claim 1 and the description concern immersive mechanisms, not availability of the complete experience on a particular model.

title: 注视与脑电协作的座舱机械臂
summary: 以注视门控脑电意图判断，根据疲劳状态调节机械臂阻抗，检测碰撞并控制收纳。
scope: 授权文本权利要求1；机械臂辅助相关。停驻取放是本库提出的受限扩展，尚未实车验证。

en.title: Gaze and EEG assisted cabin robotic arm
en.summary: Combines gaze-gated EEG intent with fatigue-aware impedance, collision detection and arm stowage.
en.scope: Granted-text claim 1 concerns robotic assistance. Parked object handling is a bounded extension proposed by this library, not a vehicle-tested result.

title: 疲劳检测与辅助驾驶停靠交接
summary: 检测疲劳后提示休息停靠点，在无回应条件下交给驾驶系统执行后续动作。
scope: 权利要求1、5；舱驾交接机制相关，不能把座舱大模型直接作为驾驶执行器。

en.title: Fatigue detection and driving-system handoff
en.summary: Connects fatigue detection to rest-stop prompts and a driving-system handoff when there is no response.
en.scope: Claims 1 and 5 concern a handoff mechanism; a cabin language model is not a driving controller.

title: 面向车外人员的车窗投影
summary: 车外摄像头检测人员后，车窗投影呈现舱内人物图像；部分权利要求联动对外音频。
scope: 授权文本权利要求1—6；对外表达载体相关，不表示完整移车协商或服务代理已实现。

en.title: Window projection for people outside a vehicle
en.summary: Uses external person detection to present an interior-person image on a window, with external audio in some claims.
en.scope: Granted-text claims 1–6 concern an expression surface, not a complete relocation negotiation or service agent.

title: 可移动柔性座舱显示系统
summary: 顶棚附近的电动机构将柔性显示屏移至前方、后方或顶上，部分实施方式供打开尾门后观看。
scope: 权利要求1—5；屏幕位置机制相关。AI协调观看位置是本库新增的产品假设。

en.title: Repositionable flexible cabin display
en.summary: An overhead carrier positions a flexible screen forward, rearward or above seats, including rear viewing with the liftgate open.
en.scope: Claims 1–5 concern display positioning; AI coordination of viewing arrangements is this library’s product hypothesis.
